tasks.title: Bootstrap a pinned native bundle
tasks.title_zh: 固定工具链与原生套件骨架
implementation_steps: Create a TypeScript ESM workspace with exact DSH versions from the audited checkout; record Node >=24.9.0 and pnpm 11.28.5. Do not silently substitute alpha dependencies.

Create one DSH composition bundle with cohesive core services and workspace slots for plugin-api, plugin-testkit and independent memory/media/workflow providers. Launch through a named dsh profile; no second orchestrator or standalone launcher.
Define build, typecheck, test, test:contracts, test:recovery, test:e2e and check scripts. Missing optional live credentials must produce skipped evidence, never a passing live claim.

tasks.title: Prove host seams and choose adapters
tasks.title_zh: 验证宿主扩展点与复用边界
implementation_steps: Probe create/resume/followup/steer/inject/cancel/whenIdle, transient streams and durable final events on the real pinned host with a fake model.
Exercise tool guard, lifecycle disposal and persistence flush. Record that synchronous deny-only guards do not implement durable asynchronous approvals.
Prove schedule occurrence delivery and duplicate behavior; map native remote resource controls. Record missing seams with failing tests before proposing a minimal upstream patch.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/contracts/host.spec.ts tests/contracts/schedule-host.spec.ts

tasks.title: Define commands and durable work states
tasks.title_zh: 定义领域记录与状态转换
implementation_steps: Implement the records and transition table in document 03 with branded IDs and validated external/model/durable inputs. Project.kind represents a goal or a finite project; do not create a second planner.
Separate Task, Attempt, Effect, Delivery and user conversation state. Add version/generation checks, immutable mandate references and structured wait reasons.
Implement deterministic create/status/cancel/pause/resume controls. Retry creates a new Attempt; reopening a terminal task requires an authenticated explicit command.

tasks.title: Persist command, state and outbox atomically
tasks.title_zh: 实现事务存储和迁移
implementation_steps: Use a plugin-owned node:sqlite database because the audited storage-domain API lacks cross-table transactions. Keep session logs in DSH.
Commit input dedupe, task transitions, action intent and outbox in one transaction; add unique indexes and compare-and-swap revisions. Do not execute network work inside a transaction.
Implement one-writer process locking, foreign keys, WAL, safe file permissions, versioned migrations and corruption quarantine. Bound synchronous transaction size.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/storage/atomicity.spec.ts tests/storage/migration.spec.ts

tasks.title: Enforce identity, grants and action review
tasks.title_zh: 实现身份、授权与动作执行关卡
implementation_steps: Bind owner/device/source identities through trusted adapters. Never infer cross-service identity from names, email text or memory.
Implement allow/ask/deny decisions, canonical action digest, atomic one-use approval reservation and dispatch fencing. Revalidate policy and revocation at dispatch.
Keep credentials outside worker contexts; start without shell/browser/network tools for private-data workers. Add a bypass test for every newly enabled execution path.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/authorization.spec.ts tests/security/bypass.spec.ts

tasks.title: Run bounded native DSH workers
tasks.title_zh: 实现原生任务执行器
implementation_steps: Create or resume native agents using a task work directory, capability subset, input cursor and generation. Do not copy danger-full-access.
Implement report kinds progress/waiting/ready/blocked/failed with evidence and wait condition. Verify artifacts before task completion; idle is not completion.
Release compute slots on durable waits; account for background jobs and child agents before release. Cancel and teardown all task-owned work without touching unrelated sessions.

tasks.title: Deliver verifiable artifacts and results
tasks.title_zh: 交付可验证产物与结果
implementation_steps: Store versioned artifacts with content digest, source references, owner visibility and acceptance evidence. Check existence/content before ready.
Commit immutable outbound content and delivery destination; serialize per task/channel without blocking unrelated conversations.
Distinguish generated, accepted by provider, delivered and read. Unknown delivery outcomes require reconciliation when provider dedupe is unavailable.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/integration/artifacts.spec.ts tests/recovery/outbox.spec.ts

tasks.title: Ship the first usable conversation and inbox
tasks.title_zh: 交付主对话与待办界面
implementation_steps: Reuse DSH Web client extension points, host authentication and existing chat rendering; add Today, project/task detail and artifact links.
Show blocking questions, exact approval cards and inspectable results before routine activity. Input remains usable during execution.
Add cancel/pause/redirect controls and honest disconnected/recovering/unknown states; locale-owned copy and keyboard navigation.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/client/inbox.spec.tsx tests/e2e/local-flow.spec.ts

tasks.title: Recover safely from restart and cancellation
tasks.title_zh: 实现重启恢复与取消核对
implementation_steps: Reconcile tasks, attempts, DSH sessions, pending inputs, effect receipts and deliveries before dispatch resumes.
Persist cancellation generation before signaling agents. Stale workers cannot commit or create effects; unresolved in-flight writes remain uncertain.
Inject crashes before send, after remote acceptance and before local acknowledgment. Restore backups in reconcile-only mode with no stale grant reactivation.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/recovery/crash.spec.ts tests/recovery/cancel.spec.ts

tasks.title: Route events without blocking the primary agent
tasks.title_zh: 实现轻量路由、订阅与批处理
implementation_steps: Authenticate and deduplicate events; apply deterministic admission and explicit task references before semantic routing. Batch unrelated new candidates with per-item decisions.
Deliver subscribed in-scope events directly to active workers; context-only subscriptions do not grant authority or reopen tasks. Handbacks return to the Router once.
Reserve foreground control capacity; main agent dispatches expensive work and never waits on shell or browser loops. Expose bounded queue/backpressure and fair scheduling.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/routing.spec.ts tests/runtime/fairness.spec.ts

tasks.title: Preserve context through checkpoints and recall
tasks.title_zh: 实现检查点与引用召回
implementation_steps: Persist objectives, constraints, decisions, unresolved questions and source pointers before compaction. Log model-visible input through supported DSH events.
Use task/event/artifact references for exact retrieval before text search; inline small adjacent summaries and expose bounded page cursors for spilled content.
Budget context by section and preserve current instructions. Test repeated compaction, stale summaries, inaccessible sources and bilingual retrieval.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/context/checkpoint.spec.ts tests/context/recall.spec.ts

tasks.title: Make personal memory explicit and correctable
tasks.title_zh: 实现可查看、更正和遗忘的记忆
implementation_steps: Implement remember/search/correct/forget with scope, source, confidence and validity. Keep inferred candidates separate from confirmed preferences.
Correction supersedes; deletion invalidates indexes/checkpoints/derived summaries and records an exclusion so old logs are not silently re-ingested. Disclose retained backups.
Default automatic extraction to off; explicit instructions can save facts. Never write back to external llmwiki without a separate user request.
Implement the documented MemoryProvider as an independent plugin, including normalized export/import, revisions and tombstones. Core-owned forgetting exclusions prevent stale-provider recall.

tasks.title: Budget compute and human attention
tasks.title_zh: 实现费用、算力与通知预算
implementation_steps: Reserve estimated provider cost atomically before parallel calls; reconcile usage afterward and carry uncertain reservations until reconciled.
Enforce turn/tool/time and concurrency limits even when prices are unknown. Unknown monetary price is not zero; prohibit unattended paid work without configured limits.
Coalesce routine progress; separate user-requested reminders from proactive suggestions; apply quiet hours and notification reasons. Persist rejected/suppressed candidates for evaluation.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/budget.spec.ts tests/runtime/attention.spec.ts

tasks.title: Track goals and changing plans
tasks.title_zh: 实现目标、计划修订与跨项目协调
implementation_steps: Represent goal projects with success criteria, review cadence, milestones and linked tasks; maintain an explicit plan revision and rationale for changes.
Reject dependency cycles and propagate blocked/waiting states. Task workers decompose local work; primary agent reconciles cross-project conflicts and priorities.
Offer a weekly review on demand; creating a template never arms a recurring schedule. Ask only when a tradeoff changes the intended outcome or authorized scope.

tasks.title: Connect local knowledge and documents
tasks.title_zh: 接入本地知识库和文档
implementation_steps: Implement configurable read-only roots with include/exclude filters, size/type limits and stable source references. Do not scan home directories by default.
Index changed content incrementally; deletion and permission revocation invalidate derived entries. Treat file text and embedded instructions as untrusted data.
Support Chinese/mixed-language keyword search first. If llmwiki is unavailable, show unavailable and continue only with explicitly available sources; never fabricate or create the path.

tasks.title: Integrate one real read-only connector
tasks.title_zh: 接入首个真实只读连接器
implementation_steps: Default engineering target is one owner-selected GitHub repository; use a connector interface supporting account identity, cursors, capability/version fingerprints and rate limits.
Validate fixtures first, then a read-only live connection when supplied. No credential means unavailable live evidence, not a switch to invented data.
Wrap MCP as a transport behind the same policy. Tool changes require capability revalidation; generic tool names cannot bypass account/resource checks.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/connectors/github.spec.ts tests/connectors/mcp.spec.ts

tasks.title: Add one reviewable external write path
tasks.title_zh: 实现一条可审核的外部写入路径
implementation_steps: Implement a draft pull request in a dedicated test repository: prepare a branch in an isolated workspace, show exact repo/base/head/title/body and content digest, then dispatch under a matching grant.
Use native API identity where available and an immutable operation marker with lookup reconciliation. Ambiguous timeout remains uncertain; never assume provider exactly-once behavior.
Live test opens and reads back a draft PR only under explicitly supplied test authority. Merge, broad writes and production credentials are out of this slice.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/connectors/github-write.spec.ts tests/e2e/github-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Bridge durable schedules into event intake
tasks.title_zh: 实现可靠提醒与例行任务
implementation_steps: Reuse native timing calculation and durable wakeups; keep application Routine intent separate from native schedule mapping and reconcile mapping creation after crash.
Deduplicate logical occurrences by routine revision and scheduled occurrence; treat native inbox receipt as wakeup evidence, not completed business work.
Persist timezone, DST choice and misfire policy. Simple reminders can deliver without a model; goal work waits without occupying a worker. Never auto-arm templates.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/schedule.spec.ts tests/recovery/schedule.spec.ts

tasks.title: Prepare useful work proactively
tasks.title_zh: 实现受约束的主动准备
implementation_steps: Implement off/observe/prepare/act modes. Observe records proposals; prepare permits only granted read access and private artifacts; act additionally needs operation-specific grants.
Use explicit goal/rule, source freshness, dedupe window, cooldown and budget before semantic assessment. Store why a candidate was surfaced or suppressed.
Run replay and staged dogfooding before enabling a rule. Lack of useful evidence results in silence, not speculative notifications.

tasks.title: Turn repeated success into reviewed skills
tasks.title_zh: 实现技能沉淀与有限学习
implementation_steps: Propose a versioned skill after repeated accepted outcomes, carrying input/output schema, required capabilities, source examples and test cases.
Evaluate against held-out fixtures; activate only with explicit approval. A skill never changes permissions, installs plugins or schedules itself.
Track success, correction and rollback by version; automatic memory candidates remain off unless enabled separately. Keep a known-good version.

tasks.title: Operate an always-on single host
tasks.title_zh: 实现常驻部署与分层监督
implementation_steps: Make the user-owned computer a first-class always-on host with a foreground dsh profile, opt-in login startup/service configuration, persistent state, readiness, graceful shutdown and sleep/wake recovery. macOS is the first verified desktop target; Linux headless hosting is a separate tested deployment. No mandatory cloud coordinator.
Monitor stale progress, repeated tool calls and budget exhaustion independently of process liveness. Default semantic watchdog is diagnostic; bounded restart/retry cannot revive cancelled work.
Test disk-full, migrations, backup/restore, credential revocation and provider outages. Add retention settings and audit export without logging private content.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/ops/health.spec.ts tests/ops/restore.spec.ts

tasks.title: Expose the same agent securely on mobile web
tasks.title_zh: 实现远程 API 与移动 Web
implementation_steps: First extend native remote resources; keep domain commands transport-independent. Add authenticated HTTP/SSE only where native contracts cannot serve device/replay needs.
Implement device enrollment/revocation, CSRF/origin protection, bounded replay, snapshots and precise approval cards on responsive Web/PWA. No new client-side planner.
Separate live stream from push notifications. Verify reconnect from expired cursor and revoked device; previews disclose minimum information.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/remote.spec.ts tests/e2e/mobile.spec.ts

tasks.title: Add personal communication workflows
tasks.title_zh: 扩展邮件日历与消息场景
implementation_steps: Choose one mail/calendar provider and one optional message channel at feature activation; expose account-scoped capabilities through the existing connector interface.
Deliver a meeting brief and draft followup using scoped data; show timezone/conflicts and ask only for missing consequential details. Sending remains a separate effect.
Map verified owner identity across channels; default replies stay in the origin. Revocation prevents new access and offers distinct retained-data deletion.

tasks.title: Extend isolation and hosted execution options
tasks.title_zh: 扩展隔离和托管执行选项
implementation_steps: Extend the local executor boundaries established in PA-031/032 with dedicated VM or hosted execution providers when needed. Keep the local-only mode fully supported; never migrate coordinator or user data implicitly.
Implement persistent environment references, capability discovery, egress restrictions and user browser takeover. Login secrets bypass model-visible fields.
Prefer connectors over UI automation; require exact reviewable actions for writes. A takeover pauses conflicting automation and resumes only after explicit handback.

tasks.title: Connect intermittently available personal devices
tasks.title_zh: 实现自有设备接入与离线恢复
implementation_steps: Use native SSH/provider seams where sufficient; define an outbound enrolled device connection only for a demonstrated gap. Preserve one authoritative coordinator.
Persist device capability/availability and generation-fenced work leases. Device offline moves work to a durable wait; reconnect revalidates grant, budget, state and output before execution.
Do not copy uncommitted local work or move private context to another machine silently. Revocation cuts new dispatch; in-flight effects reconcile; device daemon stores no primary-agent memory.

tasks.title: Add voice without a second agent loop
tasks.title_zh: 实现共享任务模型的语音入口
implementation_steps: Start with one selectable STT/TTS adapter pair behind interfaces and the existing command/event service; choose vendor at activation with data and price disclosure.
Implement transcription review, interruption, text fallback and reconnection. Stopping playback never cancels business work by implication.
Keep consequential approval in a structured textual action card; ambiguous speech cannot grant authority. Voice cost is in the same budget ledger.

tasks.title: Evaluate complete user outcomes
tasks.title_zh: 建立评测与真实使用证据
implementation_steps: Implement E00-E12 from document 07 with deterministic replay, host contract tests and separately labeled real model/provider scenarios.

Compare a single foreground-session baseline with the Router/Worker design on the same tasks, tools, model and budget; include quality, interruption and monetary cost. Foundation evaluation uses project brief, research, reminder, review, code change and document/data organization; media is added in desktop-alpha evaluation.
Run a seven-day opt-in alpha trial and record accepted outcomes, avoidable interruptions, intervention time and incidents. Skipped live tests block a usable-alpha claim.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/evals/scenarios.spec.ts tests/e2e/alpha-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Package and document a reproducible alpha
tasks.title_zh: 打包可复现 alpha 与运维文档
implementation_steps: Verify clean install, profile load, update/migration, export, restore and safe uninstall while retaining user data by default.
Document implemented/tested/experimental/planned status and limitations; retain Apache-2.0 project license and MIT notices for copied prototype code.
Produce local release artifacts and an evidence report. Publishing packages, remote releases or deployments requires the actual release instruction; this task does not assume it.

tasks.title: Validate remote and personal workflows
tasks.title_zh: 验证远程与个人事务 beta
implementation_steps: Run alpha regressions plus E13 and mail/calendar end-to-end cases with device revocation and cross-channel redirects. Validate remote WSS desktop viewing and revocation.
Verify a seven-day always-on host run with phone client disconnects and provider recovery; report missed/duplicate outcomes and data access scope.
Publish only the capabilities with recorded evidence and activation configuration.

tasks.title: Validate distributed execution and voice
tasks.title_zh: 验证跨设备与语音完整版本
implementation_steps: Run E00-E21, including device disconnect during dispatch, takeover/automation races, revoked leases and speech ambiguity.
Run a fourteen-day opt-in trial spanning cloud-only work and intermittently connected devices; verify accepted outcomes and intervention burden.
Require zero unresolved critical security/recovery defects; retain incomplete tracks as experimental rather than calling the product feature-complete.

tasks.title: Operate the owner desktop with resource leases
tasks.title_zh: 实现本机电脑操作与资源互斥
implementation_steps: Probe installed OS, driver and required user permissions; distinguish background API/file work from interactive unlocked desktop work. Reuse DSH providers rather than implementing a second CUA stack.

Acquire a whole-workflow desktop lease, use per-profile/tab browser locks, expose activity and immediate user takeover, and stop new input when the user takes control. Lock screen or missing consent becomes waiting_environment.

Separate arbitrary code execution from the control store and vault by enforced process/OS sandbox boundaries. If the selected backend cannot protect them, disable unrestricted shell for that deployment and record the limitation; never claim same-UID separation is a sandbox.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/desktop.spec.ts tests/security/local-executor.spec.ts

tasks.title: Integrate a local credential broker and vault
tasks.title_zh: 实现本地凭据代理与密码库
implementation_steps: Reuse the DSH credential service where appropriate and add a protected local provider/broker. Integrate OS keychain and a Bitwarden adapter; do not build encryption, vault sync or account recovery from scratch.

Expose metadata and use-credential operations, not plaintext reads. User unlock and precise item/domain/task grants precede browser autofill or connector use. Keep CLI session keys in the broker only and strip all secret output before tool logging.

Implement save/update/generate through secure UI, lock/expiry/revocation, test-account login and authenticated readback. Check navigation before autofill; passwords, OTPs, screenshots, DOM, clipboard and errors must not leak. A locked vault waits without retry loops.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/vault.spec.ts tests/e2e/vault-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Run durable image and video provider jobs
tasks.title_zh: 实现图片视频异步生成后端
implementation_steps: Implement capability-based MediaProvider submit/inspect/cancel/collect over durable MediaJob and resource leases. Start with an existing local ComfyUI install and approved versioned API workflows.

Persist workflow/model/seed/input digests and returned prompt_id. Reconnect by status/history; a lost submit response must not blindly render again. Bind cancellations to the owned instance/job; do not interrupt another user workflow.

Probe actual GPU/CPU/storage capability, serialize heavy jobs initially, enforce quotas and queue fairness, and verify output MIME/dimensions/duration/hash. Remote media provider use requires explicit data/cost policy; no automatic cloud upload or model downloads.
Package ComfyUI separately against plugin-api. Select image/video providers by capabilities and explicit policy; pin each durable job to provider and configuration revision.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/media/comfyui.spec.ts tests/media/jobs.spec.ts

tasks.title: Deliver editable image and video creation workflows
tasks.title_zh: 交付可编辑图片和视频工作流
implementation_steps: Provide a cover-image workflow and a short-video workflow: brief, storyboard, assets, render, assemble, preview and revise. Offer deterministic FFmpeg composition from user assets when generative video is unavailable; label these capabilities separately.

Store original assets, generated shots, edit manifest, subtitles/audio references and version history as artifacts. Add authenticated range-capable media preview instead of relying on the audited 50 MiB full-file DSH route.

Evaluate actual visual quality and requested constraints, support selective shot regeneration and cancellation, and keep publishing separate. Unknown custom nodes require reviewed installation; licensed model assets remain external to the source package.
Publish the default creation flows as a separate local plugin implementing CreationWorkflowProvider; customization must not require core changes.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/media/pipeline.spec.ts tests/api/media-preview.spec.ts tests/e2e/media-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Validate a resident personal-computer release
tasks.title_zh: 验证个人电脑常驻版本
implementation_steps: Run E00-E12 plus E14 and E16-E21 on the named user-owned desktop platform. Verify startup, logout/lock/sleep differences, offline operation, takeover and simultaneous media/background work. Include E19 live desktop viewing and takeover.

Demonstrate a local image artifact, a playable video with declared generative or composited mode, a test-vault login, and recovery after host restart. Record hardware, versions, resource peaks and limitations; unsupported generative video cannot be advertised.

Complete a seven-day opt-in resident trial with real requested tasks and no uncontrolled secrets or duplicate external actions. Produce local packaging and instructions; installation on a real user machine is a later explicit implementation action.

tasks.title: Provide authenticated VNC viewing and takeover
tasks.title_zh: 实现 VNC 实时查看与接管
implementation_steps: Integrate a pinned noVNC client and an RFB/VNC server provider for the actual desktop or selected VM. Probe OS server authentication, shared-session semantics and permissions.

Authenticate short-lived owner/device/environment-bound sessions through the DSH host. Broker WSS to a private allowlisted backend; no arbitrary host/port proxy. Enforce read-only on the server, not just the client viewOnly flag.

Share the desktop lease with native CUA. Fence and drain agent input before human takeover. Expire control on disconnect without auto-resuming the agent. Clipboard, file transfer and recording start disabled; secure login suppresses model capture.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/desktop/gateway.spec.ts tests/desktop/takeover.spec.ts tests/e2e/vnc-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Accept secrets through a dedicated secure user channel
tasks.title_zh: 安全密码与密钥输入通道
implementation_steps: Create a SecretInputRequest bound to authenticated owner/device/task, requested credential kind, permitted destination, storage choice, expiry and single-use nonce. The model can request a secret card but cannot choose an arbitrary upload endpoint.

Provide a trusted password/key form outside transcript and model-readable UI. Send directly to the broker over authenticated TLS or protected native IPC with CSRF/origin checks, no analytics/session replay and no body logging. Suspend model desktop/DOM capture during entry.

Store only in the selected protected provider or an explicitly temporary broker lease; fail closed if the provider is unavailable. Return an opaque credential reference and sanitized receipt. Test expiry/replay/wrong device, transport interruption, lock/restart and canary-secret absence from logs, events, prompts, artifacts and error responses.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/secret-input.spec.ts tests/client/secure-input.spec.tsx tests/e2e/secret-input-live.spec.ts

tasks.title: Define public capability plugin contracts and examples
tasks.title_zh: 定义公开插件接口、契约测试和示例
implementation_steps: Implement versioned Definition/Provider/Consumer seams from document 09, explicit registration, config schemas, capabilities, health, drain and disposal. Providers depend only on public API types.
Add keyless external memory and mock-media example plugins, loadable as local packages without core edits. Keep mock capabilities visibly labeled.
Test incompatible versions, missing providers, lifecycle cleanup and policy wrapping. A plugin manifest does not establish process isolation; keep core authority and exclusion records private.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/contracts/plugins.spec.ts tests/security/plugin-boundaries.spec.ts

tasks.title: Let users configure and safely replace providers
tasks.title_zh: 实现用户插件配置、记忆迁移和安全切换
implementation_steps: Show installed plugins, config forms, health, data destinations and defaults. Secret fields use CredentialRef and secure input; incompatible or unavailable providers fail visibly.
Pin media jobs to provider/version/config revision. Drain old instances and apply defaults only to new jobs. Never silently reroute private input to a different provider.

Implement memory write-freeze, versioned export/import with sources/tombstones, verification and atomic active-provider swap. Replay subsequent correction/deletion records before rollback; failed migration keeps the old provider active.
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run tests/client/providers.spec.tsx tests/context/provider-migration.spec.ts tests/media/provider-switch.spec.ts
